$comment: Not-yet-proven negative-fixture debt for check:gate-wiring (C-FEL-428).
A gate listed here has NO executed-and-observed negative-fixture proof yet.
Ruling 1: a gate is PROVEN only if its red command ran in that run and exited
non-zero — declared/registered is not enough. This list is SHRINK-ONLY: a gate
leaves it by adding a fixture-invocation entry to NEGATIVE_FIXTURES in
scripts/check-gate-wiring.ts, and it can never be ADDED to (a NEW gate must
ship a proof or the meta-check goes red). Opting a gate in requires exposing a
fixture-scan mode on that gate; the surface of THIS contract forbids rewriting
the individual gates, so that is follow-up work.
The one gate proven day-one is check:gate-wiring itself: the meta-gate is not
exempt from its own rule. Measured 2026-07-28 at origin/main b667bdcd.
ADDED 2026-08-02 (performativeUI port Track B review follow-up): check:a11y.
Not newly broken — newly VISIBLE, same shape as the check:grammar-v2 entry in
scripts/gate-wiring-baseline.json. check:a11y was already reachable (wired into
.github/workflows/storybook.yml since commit 2362b5ea), so it never showed as an
orphan; it simply never reached the negative-fixture half of this run, because
that half only executes after the orphan half returns clean, and check:cn-map /
check:animations-gallery were still NEW ORPHANs (see plan-a.yml's `check` job)
until this same follow-up wired them in. Fixing that unmasked check:a11y's own
gap, which predates and is independent of that fix.
NOT wired with a proof, and the reason is measured, not a preference: unlike
check:cn-map / check:animations-gallery (which got a BUILDLESS fixture — see
CN_MAP_DUMP_JSON / ANIMATIONS_GALLERY_*_JSON in scripts/check-gate-wiring.ts),
check:a11y's red path (scripts/check-storybook-a11y.sh) fundamentally needs a
built Storybook, a served static bundle, and a real Playwright chromium — none
of which can be faked with a committed text fixture. THIS job (`gate-wiring` in
plan-a.yml) deliberately runs with no `bun install`, no build, no Rust, and no
browser install (see that job's own comment: kept cheap so it runs on every
draft push). Giving check:a11y a real fixture here would mean adding `bun
install` + a Playwright chromium install to that job — turning a ~5s job into
a multi-minute one on every push, including drafts — which is a deliberate
trade-off for a human to make, not a side effect of unmasking one gate's debt.
A prototype WAS built and verified working (isolated fixture Storybook
config + a deliberate color-contrast violation, red/green both confirmed to
discriminate for the right reason) and then removed rather than left wired to
nothing — wiring it back in is real, low-risk follow-up once someone decides
the job's cost trade-off, or check:a11y gets its own heavier proof job the way
check:gate-wiring itself is its own job.
